summary.text: Blake Boykin is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Dante Pittman (D). He is chairman of the Wilson County School Board and owner of B&B Home Builders, a licensed contractor.

paragraphs.text: Boykin has served on the Wilson County Board of Education, representing District 6, since 2020, and his current term ends in 2028.
Ballotpedia quotes his campaign website as saying he wants to build on the experience he gained on the school board.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, which was canceled.
